metadata.title: Irish Pub Map in Japan
metadata.description: Find Irish pubs across Japan using the map and filters.

home.lead: Find an Irish pub for today’s drink by location, prefecture, or the kind of experience you are looking for.

explorer.heading: Search by map and filters
explorer.currentLocationDescription: Use your location to select the nearest listed prefecture and move the map.
explorer.currentLocationSuccess: Your location was used to show the nearest listed area.
explorer.currentLocationNoPubs: Your location was retrieved, but there are currently no listed pubs.
explorer.currentLocationDenied: Location access was not allowed. You can still search by prefecture or other filters.
explorer.currentLocationError: Your location could not be retrieved. Check your connection or device settings and try again.
explorer.currentLocationUnsupported: Location is not available in this browser. Search by prefecture or other filters instead.
explorer.help: Filter by pub name, area, or tag. Include closed pubs only when you need them.

map.unavailableDescription: WebGL is disabled or unavailable in this browser, so the map could not be initialized. Please use the pub list beside or below the map.
map.errorHeading: The map could not be loaded
map.errorDescription: Map tiles could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page. You can still use the pub list beside or below the map.
